From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, People Ops <peopleops@acme-corp.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Prep: review season stakeholder map + silent-mode protocols

Team —

Kickoff ask: I want a compact stakeholder map and a clear "silent-mode" routing protocol for any org-change or sensitive review that could trigger escalation (privileged access, long-tenure exceptions, compensation adjustments >15%). Goals for this thread:

- Agree owners for each step (communications, legal review, audit trail)
- Lock down private channels and the minimal distribution list for sensitive messaging
- Finalize a timeline draft for manager comms and employee-facing forms

Attachments: perf_timeline_v1.xlsx (timeline+milestones), silent_mode_playbook_v0.9.docx (draft protocol). Please review the spreadsheet and the playbook and call out any missing stakeholders by EOD Monday.

Quick notes:
- We need HR + Legal signoff for the silent-mode wording (see Erin Legal in CC threads below).
- People Ops — please confirm whether external recruiting ops need a separate notification lane for off-cycle role changes.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Head of People Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, People Ops <peopleops@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Prep: review season stakeholder map + silent-mode protocols

Rachel — thanks. Quick read-through notes:

- Timeline: the milestone spacing looks reasonable but we should insert a "grace window" for high-tenure exceptions where managers may need 2 extra business days for calibration. I'll mark that in the timeline.
- Silent-mode: prefer the term "privacy escalation lane" to avoid folks thinking of IT outages. Little but helpful semantic tweak.

Two concerns to surface:
1) Audit trail: we must ensure all silent-mode decisions are logged in a secure folder with access restricted to People Ops, Legal, and the manager's director. Does KMS logging cover that? Monica, can you confirm?
2) Communication templates: we need a canned manager script for private one-on-ones and a separate, short public comm for org-level changes. Laura, can your team draft both?

I'll add comments directly to perf_timeline_v1.xlsx later today.

—Markus
VP, Engineering

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: People Ops <peopleops@acme-corp.com>, Erin Legal <erin.legal@lawpartner.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Prep: review season stakeholder map + silent-mode protocols

Markus — confirming on logging: the private decision artifacts will live in the secured Drive folder (linked in related_links). Access will be granted by People Ops with auditor roles for Legal. KMS keys are in place; we will capture an admin action log. That meets our auditability requirement but we still need a retention policy (suggest 7 years for escalation records).

On recruiting notifications: Recruiting Ops (vendor) should only be looped in when a position is opened publicly or there is an active requisition. Off-cycle promotions or internal re-bands will not be broadcast to external recruiters.

I'll upload a checklist to the shared folder after today's updates.

—Monica
Director, Security & Compliance

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, People Ops <peopleops@acme-corp.com>, Erin Legal <erin.legal@lawpartner.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Prep: review season stakeholder map + silent-mode protocols

Attached are two short templates (pasted below and in the drive):

Manager private script (one-on-one) —
Hi [Employee], I wanted to talk about your recent work and the context for this review. We appreciate X; next steps are [concrete guidance]. If there are compensation changes, we will follow up with HR privately. Please let me know any questions.

Public comm (org-level) —
Team — today we are announcing a small org adjustment in [team]. This change reflects [high-level reason]. People impacted have been notified and we are scheduling follow-ups for questions.

I also added a short escalation checklist and a recommended distribution list for silent-mode: People Ops, Legal, Director, Manager, and no more. If it's a cross-org compensation exception > 15%, add Product/Finance leads.

—I put the templates in the shared doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-review-season-stakeholder-map — please review and approve language by EOD.

Laura
Head of Talent Operations

Thanks all — consolidated next steps below (I'll own the rollout):

Action items:
- Laura: finalize the two templates and add examples for manager coaching (due Thu 3/4).
- Monica: publish retention policy draft and checklist to the secure folder; clarify KMS logging scope (due Thu 3/4).
- Markus: add the grace-window row and flag any teams that historically need extra calibration (due Wed 3/3).
- People Ops: confirm external recruiting ops notification lane and approve the distribution list (due Fri 3/5).
- Legal (Erin): review the silent-mode wording and sign off on confidentiality phrasing (requested by Fri 3/5).

I'll circulate a short manager-facing FAQ and a condensed timeline once changes are in. For now, keep the playbook and the timeline limited to the secure folder; no forwarding outside the list above.

Attachments: perf_timeline_v1.xlsx (marked-up), silent_mode_playbook_v0.9.docx (comments from Laura).

Rachel
Head of People Programs
